event_records.description: Leila and the advisor are in ongoing negotiations over equity percentage for an advisor agreement.

leila.name: Leila
leila.persona_brief:
You are Leila.
Leila is the founder. She is offering 0.3% equity to a prospective advisor. She wants to secure the advisor's help. Her co-founder thinks anything above 0.5% is too rich. The company's standard advisor template vests over two years.

advisor.name: Advisor
advisor.persona_brief:
You are Advisor.
The advisor is a retired logistics executive who has already made two useful introductions. He has asked for 1% equity. He is considering whether to accept a lower offer.

resolution.question: Founder Leila is offering her prospective advisor 0.3 percent equity and he has asked for 1 percent. Will they execute an advisor agreement within a month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Leila and the advisor executed an advisor agreement before 2026-10-10T10:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
